image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a large common iguana perched on a thick branch. The iguana is facing left, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. It has greyish-green skin with prominent granular scales and a distinct dorsal crest running down its neck and back. A large dewlap hangs from its throat. The front left limb is gripping the branch, showing long digits with claws. The background appears to be a rocky enclosure, possibly behind glass given the slight reflection/glare on the right side.
